name: fuckfacebook
description: Build and test tooling for the Fuck Facebook browser extension

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.test:unit: node tests/timer.cjs && node tests/timer.cjs --worker && node tests/timer-android.cjs && node tests/timer-debug.cjs
scripts.lint:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
